ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the point $O$ is a point on the line $AB$, $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$, $\angle COE=90^\circ$, if $\angle AOC=40^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle DOE$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $O$ is a point on the line $AB$ and $\angle AOC=40^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BOC=180^\circ-\angle AOC=140^\circ$.\\
Since $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$, \\
we have $\angle COD=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=70^\circ$.\\
Given $\angle COE=90^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle DOE=\angle COE-\angle COD=\boxed{20^\circ}$.
